claim: GreenBook's support page documents separate climate-risk reports, adaptation plans and Maps & Data Packages, while its MetroView index lists a Johannesburg profile. The support-page content does not conclusively establish downloadable Johannesburg package availability; treat the download/API and reuse status as unresolved and verify them with the publisher rather than infer either availability or absence.

coverage.place_label: City of Johannesburg; catalogue-level availability question

method.description: Cross-check of two public GreenBook pages with different purposes; no direct file download or API call was tested.

uncertainty.description: The website text and accessible listing are insufficient to conclude whether a city-specific file package is available behind another route or upon request.

review.rationale: Open data-discovery question intended to prevent assumptions about access or licensing.

limitations: An unresolved catalogue listing is not proof that no data package exists.
Access to an interactive tool does not imply API access or redistribution rights.
Follow up with CSIR/GreenBook before implementation depends on a specific download.
